'''''Electro''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]] that was used by the [[Airam Clans|Airam]]. When [[Tamaron]] was offered to use the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|X7 Factory]] ''[[Gallofree]]'' to swap the recently [[Battle of Swellen|captured]] [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] [[Compellor/Legends|''Compellor's'']] [[Gravity well projector/Legends|Gravity well]] technology onto a [[Strike-class medium cruiser]] [[Peregrine (Strike-class)|''Peregrine'']]. While [[Second attack on the Peregrine|another]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrol was dispatched to investigate the [[First attack on the Peregrine|disappearance]] of the first patrol. While [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] held the Imperial forces long enough for the ''Electro'' to board the shuttle to provide finishing touches to the ''Peregrine'' so that it can be made ready for duty and the cruiser escaped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] while the Rebel fighters destroyed all Imperial forces to prevent any witnesses.
